Restaurant's favorite review
Beautiful Food and Staff
Jul 2026 • Couples
Definately some of the best Seafood in Vietnam. The staff were very friendly and professional but the standout was “My” who specially organised food for me because of my food allergies . She went out of her way for us which kept us coming back 3 times for diner . Beautiful atmosphere. Highly recommend . ❤️
Insider tip:
The highlight of our trip . Staying in the hotel and dining here
Value
Service
Food
Atmosphere
Written July 30, 2026
Caravelle F&B Team
Dear I2471AXshelleyr,

Thank you for your heartfelt review and for choosing Buffet Nineteen not just once, but three times during your stay.

We are truly delighted to know that you enjoyed our seafood selection, the beautiful atmosphere, and the warm hospitality provided by our team. It is especially rewarding to hear that My made such a meaningful difference to your dining experience by thoughtfully arranging meals to accommodate your food allergies. Your kind recognition of her dedication and genuine care will certainly be shared with her, as it will mean a great deal.

Knowing that our team's personalized service inspired you to return for dinner three times is the highest compliment we could receive. Thank you for your recommendation and for placing your trust in us.

We look forward to welcoming you back to Buffet Nineteen for many more memorable dining experiences.

From the heart of Saigon
Caravelle F&B Team

Chúng tôi rất vui mừng khi biết Quý khách và bạn bè đã có một trải nghiệm ẩm thực thật trọn vẹn, ngon miệng từ các món chính đến quầy tráng miệng, đặc biệt là sự đa dạng và tươi ngon của nguồn hải sản tươi sống. Sự ghi nhận này chính là nguồn động lực quý báu để tập thể nhân viên không ngừng nỗ lực mang lại dịch vụ tận tâm nhất mỗi ngày.

Kính chúc Quý khách cùng bạn bè luôn nhiều niềm vui và rất mong sẽ sớm được tiếp tục chào đón cả nhóm quay trở lại Nineteen Restaurant trong những dịp gặp gỡ tiếp theo!

Seafood Food Coma
Jun 2023 • Family
Buffet is well organized and clean, as the seating was comfortable and spacious. The hot foods selection was decent, but not plentiful. However, you can order a large variety of seafood that's cooked to order in multiples ways depending on your taste. Every selection was cooked well, and the seafood was notably fresh, lobster had a bouncy, slightly "crispy" flesh, and the abalone wasn't overly chewy. The head butter in the tiger prawns is also something not to miss. Some other notable selections include seared foie gras, raw oysters, and a cheese bar. 

Sushi selection was small, but the sashimi tasted very fresh, the salmon deliciously buttery, surf clams have a clean taste and snappy texture.

The dessert bar was quite plentiful and delicious, with a variety of choices that will suit almost everybody, my personal favourites being the raspberry mousse, flan, and tiramisu. Ice cream bar had four flavours: rum raisin, chocolate, mint chip, and strawberry. My favourite was the strawberry. They also had a chocolate fountain.

The service was also very kind and warm.

Check out @bredgyeats for a video showcase of the selection!

Made reservations and came with family for the dinner/seafood buffet over the weekend. Has to be one of the best I've ever had. The seafood was amazing and the options were fantastic. Lobster, mussels, oysters, crab, chicken, lamb, beef, etc. all cooked to order. Also had a great salad bar, pizza options, cooked veggies, local cuisine, sushi, etc.. The dessert bar was a big hit for kids with chocolate fondue, an ice cream bar, pie/tarts, cookies, everything. 

Make reservations ahead of time. It's on the pricey side but was worth every penny. The seafood buffet is about 1.1 million VND per adult and you have add-on options for drinks that goes from water/soda/seltzer all the way up to open bar dependent on what you want. A great family outing with some of the best seafood I've had. 

It's also significant as this hotel remains a historical landmark in Saigon. After dinner, consider taking the lift to the rooftop bar (Saigon Saigon) for views of the city that mirror those seen by travelers in the 1950s-70s. Excellent venue with great service.

Incredible seafood buffet - don't miss it
Jul 2013 • Couples
We wanted a memorable feast and we got one! Not cheap ($56 per head) and my husband seriously let down the side by filling up too early. The range was amazing so if you want to try just one of those weird and wonderful shellfish or snails you've seen at the markets then this is the place for you. There is a great variety of Japanese style sushi and sashimi, smoked fish, crab and lots of oysters and clams. There are also shrimp (prawns) and lobster which you select and then choose how you want cooked - steamed or grilled. There are fish on skewers and marinated fish pieces which are also cooked on demand. To support this amazing selection there are also many other delectable dishes just waiting to be sampled, rice noodles and vegetables most featuring fishy heroes. The seafood chowder should not be missed either - it is sublime. If you have any room left you could sample some of the whole sea bass waiting for you in the large platter right at the end of the area. Then there are the desserts, as previously mentioned all delicious looking and I'm sure their taste did not disappoint but by then I was almost full. My husband revived sufficiently to try a creme caramel and pronounced it excellent. I was disappointed not to have room for the ice-cream and I could not persuade him to try on my behalf. I had to sample the gorgeous french cheeses - perfectly ripened and accompanied by some lovely pieces of fresh fruit. Red or white wine was included in the price of the buffet and the diligent staff ensured that our glasses were topped up appropriately. Service was very good, plates were cleared while we were restocking the next platter and finger bowls were provided without being requested. All in all a fantastic seafood extravaganza, just make sure you starve yourself for a day or two before hand and allow plenty of time to enjoy all the delights it has to offer. If you happen to be dining with a non fish eater there were also many many meat options (steaks and cutlets cooked to order as well as a carvery) which would keep them more than happy too.
